profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, trading under the ticker EFX. SEC records list it under Central Index Key 0000033185. The company describes itself as a credit bureau that provides credit reports and credit scores for businesses and consumers. Its website also promotes identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product called Equifax Complete. The site says that if a customer becomes a victim of identity theft, dedicated ID Restoration Specialists will work on their behalf to help them recover.

The available material does not describe any AI-specific products or MCP servers. Records also show 105 law exposure entries in Georgia. No individual cases are listed.
